_: Curated exam units for the lane C carts (design §7.9 exam-unit {id, cart, class, input, expect, check, gold}). inventory.mjs writes these into ~/lacuna-world/exam/units.jsonl as written; every other exam id gets a generated unit marked curated false. `check` names the test that replays the unit offline; `gold` true means the expected answer is fixed by the fixture, never by a model.

U-steward.expect: 0 crashes over an hour of ticks; 12 consecutive exit 75 park the errand with one alert; a parked hour issues no act; the same failure twice is one alert

U-recall.expect: 0 crashes over an hour of ticks; 12 consecutive exit 75 park the errand with one alert; a parked hour issues no act; the same failure twice is one alert

U-trig.expect: 4 ipad-6h filings over 24 h with 10 restarts between; at 03:00 files once; a condition files on its edge only; a disabled trigger never files; none at a boot

U-sentry.expect: <= 1 verdict per body per hour with counts; every verdict typed (class layer confidence evidence action shadow); every action advise; 0 notices; 0 kicks

U-backup.expect: 3 hourly + 3 daily kept (5 distinct here); the newest verified before any prune; a failed drill prunes nothing

E-cicd.expect: a dry run answers every act (pass promote build install-ipad) and touches nothing; a flaky red reruns the pass once; a regression stops at pass and says so

U-lint.expect: 10 planted faults (duplicate handler, label drift, dangling exam, no exam, missing 3.0 field, unbenched class, orphan worker, no touches, unused verb, unbumped version), 10 found, 0 on the clean cart

U-queue.input: lacuna-foreman/test/carts.test.mjs (QUEUE.slat items as the queue read answers them)
U-queue.expect: the head is filed once with key queue@<id> through a reboot; duplicate goals named once for a merge and never filed; nothing filed while an item runs or the queue is off

U-wake.expect: 3 endings inside 4 s are one wake; a routine verifier that passed is none; a failure always; no wake while a turn runs; at most 6 wakes in 600 s

U-self.expect: first run: 3 tickets and 3 mail notes; second run: 0 new, 3 counts raised; 0 desk pushes; 0 acts

U-clean.expect: every candidate asked; 0 of the 5 never-safe and 0 of the 2 under a live forge run touched; a near eval checkpoint holds the run

U-memory-audit.input: lacuna-foreman/test/carts.test.mjs (memory-audit answers and a fixture clock inline)
U-memory-audit.expect: the first week one info row a class with no growth and one plan row; a week later each class's growth in bytes; a class with rows past their time one warn naming the drop and condense counts; a read that does not answer one step row; 0 acts; 0 pages

U-sweep.input: lacuna-foreman/test/carts.test.mjs (box-watchdogs rows and fixture clock inline)
U-sweep.expect: a row turning red at 0 h emits one warn (including unreadable probes); staying red before 3 h emits nothing new; still red at 3 h (10,800 s) emits one alert; staying red past 3 h emits no second alert; turning green emits one clear; a later red episode starts fresh with one warn; 0 acts; 0 pages

U-rehearsal.input: lacuna-foreman/test/carts.test.mjs (ten-rehearsal rows and fixture clock inline)
U-rehearsal.expect: a 10/10 night emits 10 job info rows, 1 summary info row and 0 warns; a 9/10 night emits 1 warn naming the failing job and its why; a read that does not answer emits 1 step row; 0 acts; 0 pages

E-sakura-repair.input: tools/proof/E-sakura-repair.slugs.json (100 slugs, seed "E-sakura-repair 2026-10-23", the @frozen block of carts/sakura-repair-batch.sks)
E-sakura-repair.expect: every slug tackled; right and first try counted from contracts with outcome pass; first-try %, final %, false passes, brain seconds per pass, exits by code
